title: Assert completion_events rows survive purgeHistory with purgedAt set, not just that the tombstone view is empty

evidence.quote: // Completions are tombstoned (purgedAt set), not deleted.

why: getCompletionsByTrack reads completionsView, which already filters purgedAt IS NULL. A regression that hard-deletes completion_events rows inside TrackDao.purgeHistory — instead of tombstoning them, breaking the C3/N8 append-only invariant documented at track_dao.dart:404-406 — would produce the exact same empty result from this test. The test's own comment claims to verify 'tombstoned, not deleted' but its assertions cannot distinguish the two outcomes.
recommendation: Add a raw query against completion_events (bypassing completionsView) asserting the row count for the track is unchanged from before the purge and that purgedAt is non-null on every row.
acceptance_criteria: Test additionally selects raw completion_events rows for trackId after purgeHistory and asserts row count is unchanged and purgedAt is non-null on each
Changing purgeHistory's tombstone UPDATE to a DELETE causes this test to fail

corrections: learning_tracker/test/core/database/daos/track_dao_test.dart:336-408 (group 'R6-11: purgeHistory curriculumId isolation') already exercises purgeHistory via a raw select on completionEvents (bypassing the view) and asserts purgedAt isNotNull/isNull — this would catch a hard-delete regression in purgeHistory even though the cited epic_18 test would not. Downgrading P2→P3 accordingly.
